description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy and correlation performance of various models across three evaluation metrics: Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy. The horizontal axis displays five different model configurations: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis represents the combined metric of Accuracy/Correlation, scaled from 0 to 0.8. Each model configuration has three bars corresponding to the three metrics, with Sentiment Acc. represented by a light yellow bar, STS Corr. by a pink bar, and Paraphrase Acc. by a light blue bar. For all models, the Paraphrase Accuracy (light blue) consistently shows the highest values, often exceeding 0.78. The STS Correlation (pink) values are generally high, with the 2-Tier SimCSE model achieving the highest STS Correlation, slightly above 0.8. The Sentiment Accuracy (light yellow) values are the lowest across all models, typically ranging between 0.5 and 0.52. The 2-Tier SimCSE model consistently outperforms the others across all three metrics, particularly in STS Correlation and Paraphrase Accuracy, indicating its superior robustness in generating sentence embeddings.
